arguments.description: Replace all houses, roots and foliage with one reusable suspended rope-and-timber footbridge, left-to-right across the image. Detailed planks, bound knots, thick hand ropes, vertical posts and reinforced end landings. Shallow three-quarter view shows the walkway surface and front edge. Ends remain unobstructed for attaching platforms. Match the source's wood palette, crisp pixel density, dark selective outlines and upper-left light. Transparent background, no supports or scenery.
